hasImage.description: When true, only include posts whose `images` array is non-empty.
hasImage.title: Has Image

maxItems.description: Maximum posts to return across all start URLs.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Optional maximum price filter (USD). Applied to the numeric portion of the listing price when present.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price

minPrice.description: Optional minimum price filter (USD). Applied to the numeric portion of the listing price when present.
minPrice.title: Minimum Price

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Craigslist typically works from datacenter IPs with no proxy — leave off for lowest cost.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

scrapeDetails.description: Fetch each post's page for full description, attributes, coordinates and images. Off = listing-card data only (title, url, price, location).
scrapeDetails.title: Scrape Post Details

searchTerm.description: Optional keyword; appended to each search URL as ?query=<term>. Ignored for direct post URLs.
searchTerm.title: Search Term

startUrls.description: Craigslist search URLs or direct post URLs. Examples: https://sfbay.craigslist.org/search/jjj, https://newyork.craigslist.org/search/hhh, or a full post URL like https://sfbay.craigslist.org/eby/grd/d/hayward-item/7918207144.html
startUrls.title: Start URLs
